verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a cap table management product, but the evidence pack never documents a permissioned data room or any way to share cap table views and documents with outside counsel or investors. The closest items are adjacent: documents attached to securities, stakeholder ownership views, and Excel cap table downloads. None of these is a shared, access-controlled diligence room.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can share a permissioned, diligence-ready data room — cap table views plus underlying documents — with counsel and investors
